release_notes:
• Scrubbing a streaming song can no longer silence or freeze the player: the audio engine is never rebuilt mid-playback — nearby seeks are instant, and a far seek cleanly switches to the downloaded file at the position you picked
• Fast drags are coalesced: playback always lands on the last spot you released the scrubber on
• Credit & welcome page: only shown once the settings store confirms a first install — it can no longer reappear on every launch
• Player artwork is sharper: covers are requested at the highest 500x500 rendition and rendered with high-quality filtering
